title: Automatic satin qualification with world-frame fidelity protection

methodology.inputs: 32 byte-hashed sources: 9 native SVGs and matched transparent PNGs, repository Nike SVG and raster derivative, 4 actual logo bitmaps including the original Nike lettering attachment, 4 scale/translation controls, 4 dominant-fill/round-detail controls.
methodology.physical_sizing: Native documents use declared 80mm width. Paired PNG design width equals foreground crop pixels +2 padding pixels divided by source raster 24px/mm, preserving physical artwork size rather than scaling every crop to80mm. Real logos use80mm and fit_to_hoop=True.
methodology.common_top_audit: Frozen 46b4397 quality.py, quantized actual top-layer blocks, nominal thread0.3mm, 305dpi, structural tolerance0.25mm. Underlay/locks/travel excluded. Combined and per-colour metrics audited. Structural100% is not literal100% thread coverage or sewout.
methodology.component_audit: Same-colour footprint clipped to source component bbox +1mm. Used to isolate small circles beside large same-colour fills. Nearby stitching of the same colour can contribute locally. Old plans reconstructed from exported top_layer_runs; all17 per-colour metrics reproduced exactly before regional audit.
methodology.machine: PES/DST decoded, same stitch coordinates and colour changes as quantized plan; PES same thread colours, configured hoop and stitch/jump bounds. Byte hashes stored. Rejected proposed connections are not emitted unsafe machine stitches.
methodology.initial_vs_final: Initial qualification changed9plans, including lower literal coverage on4phase controls. Final fidelity guard retained their preceding fill machine files and changed only5plans. Initial evidence is retained to expose this rejected outcome.
methodology.performance: Full generate() API with compare_strategies=False, including input interpretation, planning, preview and PES/DST export. Fresh process per source/case; one warm-up discarded then five timed repeats. Imports, machine decoding and independent geometry audits are outside timers. Repeated PES/DST hashes are streamed with4KiB buffers outside timers. Three sources run sequentially after root tests/build/browser QA finished. Environment is a local development Mac; no root test/build loads during timing, OS load not controlled.
methodology.memory: macOS resource.RUSAGE_SELF.ru_maxrss in bytes, process high-water RSS captured immediately after each generate() before decoding/geometry audits; maximum across six runs. Includes imports, warm-up and retained/cached allocations. Tiny streaming hash buffers from preceding repeats may be included. This is process RSS, not allocated algorithm memory. Quality-run RSS is excluded.
methodology.deduplication: On all32 balanced cases, main and previous have identical command/thread hashes, PES/DST bytes, machine roundtrips, and combined/per-colour/per-component common audits. Shared baseline fields represent both. Final fields marked same_as_baseline were individually checked, not inferred only from stitch count.
methodology.final_snapshot: Final snapshot also includes the variant ranking coverage guard; all32 balanced plans and metadata were regenerated and exactly match the guarded snapshot. Four compare_strategies=True controls verify the coverage field and recommended choice separately. Input preparation is byte-unchanged from0.6.2.
methodology.satin_spacing_diagnostic: Final non-edge quantized satin nodes two penetrations apart; p05/p50/p95 and count. No reconstruction of rails, no baseline comparison when old report lacks this field, no sewn stitch-regularity score.

limits.physical_validation: Geometric thread model and machine roundtrip do not establish textile sewout quality, tension, puckering or manufacturer acceptance.
limits.unchanged_logos: Phoenix/Falcon/Nike balanced plans remain unchanged. Satin-preferred already gives alternative safe textures on these examples, but Auto does not force satin across every broad logo region.
limits.phase: Guarded fine-ring/thin translated copies retain their old fill plans. This prevents the new lower-fidelity satin result; it does not make source translations produce identical machine points.
limits.mixed_stitch_types: Qualified small round satin details intentionally coexist with broad tatami areas of the same colour. A single stitch type is not itself a quality criterion.
limits.preexisting_omissions: Three tiny regions in Nike native SVG and two in multicolour PNG are omitted in all three balanced references; unchanged by this patch. The new Auto is not a complete absence-of-omissions guarantee.
limits.thread_footprint: Nominal0.3mm thread at0.4mm density gives literal gaps in tatami; structural tolerance0.25mm is a distance criterion, not proof of total fabric coverage. Small preexisting structural gaps remain in Phoenix/Pepsi. No sewn samples evaluated.

source_hashes.name: nike-bitmap
source_hashes.source_note: Existing rasterized repository swoosh, not the original Nike lettering screenshot.

comparison_mode.method: compare_strategies=True, same physical/fabric settings as balanced. No repeated performance claim; variant quality coverage asserted equal to exported stats.coverage in final.

reproduction.harness: output/engine-consolidation/auto-satin/benchmark.py (ignored local wrapper, reuses scripts/benchmark_fill_methods.py and benchmark_reliability.py)
reproduction.performance_command: .venv/bin/python output/engine-consolidation/auto-satin/benchmark.py --source-root output/engine-consolidation/auto-satin/source-candidate-release/src --label perf-release --policy balanced --mode performance --repeats 5 --names ring-svg fine-ring-scale075-zero-svg s-curve-svg tight-curve-svg straight-svg multicolor-svg phoenix-bitmap nike-lettering-bitmap
reproduction.baseline_commands: Same command with source-main/perf-main and source-previous/perf-previous; sequential isolated workers, identical byte-hashed corpus/settings.
reproduction.local_inputs: Raster logo inputs remain local; report contains hashes and basenames, no external personal paths or image payloads.
